notes.title: Ammunition Reload System Optimization
notes.content:
New "Ready Rack" Mechanism
A more realistic reloading workflow has been implemented:

When shells are stored in the ready rack, reload speed is significantly faster.

Once the ready rack is depleted, shells are transferred from other racks, resulting in a slightly longer reload time.

The default reload time for ready rack shells has been adjusted for better balance.
This mechanism adds strategic depth to ammunition management and creates a more realistic and tactical firing rhythm.

Ammo Rack System Upgrade

The number of shells displayed in ammo rack models must now match the configured data (requires mod adaptation).

Modders can now define custom ammo rack usage order for more flexible reload logic.

Main and secondary gun ammo racks are now separated, allowing independent configuration and behavior control.

The Tank Workshop now supports custom ammunition count settings and rack-module binding.

Shell types with capacity limits will no longer trigger the fast reload behavior for the first round.

Fixed an issue where failure to carry Shell Type 1 prevented drum magazine reloading.

Tank Workshop Enhancements
Turrets and gun barrels can now be linked to specific modules such as gunner, loader, ammo rack, and elevation mechanism, enabling greater flexibility in module configuration.

Armor Monitor Improvements
Added a new "Filter by Module Type" feature, allowing players to display specific components such as engine, ammo rack, and fuel tank for more efficient identification.

AI Behavior Enhancements
AI now supports patrol waypoints for naval units, enabling automatic navigation along water-based routes and improving AI behavior in naval combat scenarios.

Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where turret rotation direction could behave abnormally in some cases.

Increased the default lifetime of slow-speed shells.

notes.title: Panzer War : Definitive Edition for Beta Test!
notes.content:
After 5 month of hard development, Panzer War and Cry of War has been updated to brand new version! And the combination of two games is called Panzer War : Panzer War : Definitive Edition now. This version uses the new rendering features. And it is compatible with old mods. This news will introduce all the new features one by one.

[b]New Lighting for tanks[/b]

The tank textures are re-made with PBR technology.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32080170/a7c401199511c81c0e0dd95fd651815554ab0805.png[/img]

You can set the level of dirty in camouflage settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32080170/be5e27a721ae666196d256bb3cd98e8fd14a3480.png[/img]

[b]Module-Based Mechanics[/b]

The Panzer War and Cry of War are combined. So module-based mechanics have been added to PanzerWar:DE. It includes module-based damage mechanic and hp-based damage mechanic. You can select different damage mechanic in the game option. The game uses the new rendering pipelines. The module-based damage is similar to War Thunder. It calculates how shell damage internal modules and gives the x-ray replay. The hp-based damage is similar to World of Tanks. 

[/b]
[olist]
[*] Different ammos damage internal modules differently.
[*] Ammo count affects the size of ammo shell.
[*] Not all the tanks are available for module-based mode.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32080170/63ec08718ecce254c2db7bac07831f735874673e.png[/img]

[b]Heat Thermal[/b]

You can open Heat Thermal on modern tanks by pressing Z button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32080170/b925953d151706a03cb8803c50dd3026512a6472.png[/img]

[b]Armor Inspector[/b]

You can view armor by new armor inspector.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32080170/e331d3869aee1e6ea36813c9c6afc40479a83c6d.png[/img]

FAQ

1. Why is my subscribed mod missing?

To accelerate mod development, some of the community mods are assembled together. If you do not want bot to play some of them, you can ban it in the game setting.  

Subscribe it from : https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2433178511

notes.title: The update 1.03 has come.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32080170/4790a8624a71cea6ce74cea85ac3911cd4133b92.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]New Tank![/b][/h1]

One new WW2 tank, Char Bis 1, has been added to the game. It features with 75 mm main gun and 37 mm main gun on its turret. Of course, both of the guns can shoot in the game.
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32080170/240d02f8609d0aa3c4bd9e02cd248cf49306b332.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]New Mode[/b]
[/h1]What’s more, a new game mode “Historical Template-based mode” is added to Cry of War.

In Cry of War, you can set your nation, and the range of vehicle you can select will be limited due to your nation. And that is a non-respawn game mode.
 



As to the Panzer War,[u] the new game mode RTS mode has joined the desktop version.[/u]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32080170/8d2801f87c475b0cff6a0c50abacada3713f4285.jpg[/img]
The control of RTS mode: (The tutorial has not been added to the game now. So look at the following control guidance)

[list]
[*] W A S D to move the camera. Q E to rotate the camera.
[*] Left mouse: click to select a single unit.
[*] Drag mouse with holding the left mouse to draw a selection box to select units
[*] Right mouse: click to attack the enemy
[*] Drag mouse with holding the right mouse to draw an arrow for where the selected units look for.
[*] Hold left ctrl and left click on the map to attack any place on the map.
[/list]

A new mission called “Fury” is added to the Panzer War.
In this mission, you will be the commander of four Sherman tanks and you will encounter the Tiger.
 

Also, a new game mode “Historical Template-based mode” is added to Panzer War. It is an RTS game mode. The goal in this mode is to destroy all enemy units.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32080170/b99040a32d9060e2161fffc54c98e210348a6f9b.jpg[/img]

[b]Update and Enjoy it now! And share the news of the game update to your friends.[/b]
